jobs.title: Operations Manager, Therapy Program

jobs.title: Operations Manager

jobs.title: Founding Product Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong systems-oriented role building product operations from the ground up: customer feedback systems, dashboards, reporting, tooling, documentation, operating rhythms, and cross-functional alignment. Kevin’s Salesforce, workflow automation, requirements translation, and process design experience fit well.

jobs.title: Operations Excellence and Innovation Manager, YouTube

jobs.gap: YouTube may expect deeper large-scale tech operations and analytics experience. Kevin should quantify scope, adoption, cycle-time improvements, and automation impact while keeping SQL at foundational/working knowledge.

jobs.title: Revenue Strategy & Operations Manager

jobs.gap: Whatnot may prefer deeper hands-on MarTech and growth-stack ownership. Kevin should focus on automation, CRM/process design, reporting, implementation, and enablement rather than SEO.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager

jobs.gap: This is a substantial stretch because Revolut typically expects stronger strategy, analytics, and high-growth operating depth. Kevin should apply only with a tightly positioned Business & Systems Operations résumé and quantified outcomes.
